newsitem.title: BRAZIL: RESEARCH ALERT-TELEMIG STILL A BUY.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-TELEMIG STILL A BUY.

text.p: ING Barings said it maintained its buy recommendation on Brazilian telecoms operator Telemig with a 12-month price ratget of $237.50 per 1,000 shares.

-- ING Barings analyst Vera Rossi said in a report the target price for Telemig, a unit of federal holding Telebras TEL_p.SA serving Minas Gerais state, indicates a potential total return of 44 percent.

-- She said Telemig's reported second-quarter earnings of 127 million were above ING's forecast of 112.1 million. Net revenues of 405.9 million reais in the second quarter also were 11 percent above the bank's forecast of 360.7 million reais, she added.
-- Local and domestic long-distance usage decreased from same quarter last year, the firm installed fewer cellular and fixed lines than expected and cellular expansion slowed down, Rossi said.
-- Second-quarter operating expenses grew 9.4 percent quarter-on-quarter to 190 million reais, some 10.2 percent above the bank's forecast, she said.
-- Telemig common was up 1.15 percent at 176 reais at 1435 local/1735 GMT in Sao Paulo.
